（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

S. I. D.
380
8/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

June 7th 1916.

Sir,
On 5th inst the Nantao Chamber of Commerce advanced $20,000 to General Yang who paid the troops an advance of wages of $1.00 each. Arrangements are being made to pay the balance within a day or two.
The Arsenal authorities and soldiers have received information of Yuan Shih Kai's death unofficially and the news does not seem to have caused any unrest.
General Yang has not been officially informed of the President's demise.
Extraordinary precautions were taken in Chinese territory last night in accordance with instructions from Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang.
Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang has telegraphically instructed the Director of the Arsenal to send 60 boxes of ammunition to Nanking to-day.
The rebels have been planning to cause an insurrection at Soochow but it is thought that the death of the President will cause them to alter their plans.
Sun Yat Sen who is at present in the French Concession has changed his address two or three times recently and he rarely sleeps two nights running in the same place. The French Authorities have hinted that he had better leave. It is very difficult to assume his safety at the present moment and they do not desire any more assassinations in the Settlement.

Your Obedient Servant,

McLaughlin
Chief Detective Inspector.

（批：AH） Captain Superintendent of Police.

警务处，
（侦探股。）

S. I. D.
380
16年6月8日

致上海工部局。

1916年6月7日。

先生：

本月5日，南市商会向杨将军垫付了20,000美元，杨将军以此向士兵每人预付了1.00美元的工资。余款预计在一两天内付清的安排正在进行中。

兵工厂当局和士兵们已非正式获悉袁世凯死讯，该消息似乎未引起任何动荡。

杨将军尚未正式获知总统逝世的消息。

昨晚，根据姜春峰口长（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang，音译）的指示，在华界采取了特别预防措施。

姜春峰口长（Chiangchun Feng Kou Chang，音译）已电令兵工厂总监今日向南京发送60箱弹药。

反叛者一直策划在苏州发动暴乱，但据信总统之死将促使他们改变计划。

目前身处法租界的孙中山最近已两三次更换住址，他很少连续两晚睡在同一地方。法国当局已暗示他最好离开。目前很难保证他的安全，且他们不希望租界内再发生刺杀事件。

您顺从的仆人，

麦克劳林
首席侦探督察

（批注：AH） 警察总巡官。
